notes: Native-only runs alternate AB/BA order; the long microbatch-64 run has 100 timed pairs and the shorter runs have 20. External workloads remain running, so absolute timings and gain size vary. Profile duration shares describe the candidate; traces at different load are not a before/after speedup test. Final numerically validated binary only; rejected pilot excluded. Existing tolerances unchanged. Two excluded warmups and ten interleaved complete-update samples. Each case starts from the same archive and fixed 64-transition batch. Gradients, clipping, optimizer, JSON input and status are within full-update timing; first-use JIT/capture is retained in warmups. GPU memory is sampled worker process usage, not peak allocations. Logical intermediate outputs are not measured DRAM traffic. PyTorch compiled BF16 uses a different arithmetic/storage policy; short f32 checks do not establish BF16 learning-quality parity.
